verdict.rationale: Superpowers' automations are plain markdown skill folders that are selectively installable and kept as a git-tracked source of truth. Its agent workflows run in git worktrees, use per-task code review and approval gates, and treat git history as the durable record, with the option to open a PR, merge, or stop. That gives indirect versioning and review through git, but there is no first-class mechanism for versioning, diffing, or rolling back the automations or skills themselves. missing for 10: explicit skill/automation version pinning, a documented rollback of skills or agent runs, review tooling for automation changes, independent corroboration.
